_doc: Aegean Shore bosses (GAME_DESIGN.md: Bosses; Regional boss roster). Each has 3 phases at HP thresholds, patterns from the shared library (data in config patterns, overridden here), named casts with cast bars, a Guard gauge (damage fills it, weakness hits fill it x2; when full: Guard Break, stunned 4 s, +50% damage taken, cast cancelled, then the gauge refills slower), and one signature mechanic from its myth.
